justification: Nothing on this roster earned a seat change this week, so we don't make one just to look busy. Cousins has done his job all year and he's starting. Hampton and Andrews responded last week when we leaned on them and that buys trust, not a bench trip over a quiet matchup. Dowdle's been showing up every Sunday at that FLEX spot and Corum's got the bye in Los Angeles anyway, so that one's not even a choice. St. Brown and Allen are both healthy and doing their jobs, and the Chargers D hasn't even kicked off yet, so they stay in over a defense that already punched its card for the week. Clear eyes, full hearts — we run it back with the guys who earned it.
